summary: @Ebonyteach Can I please spend hour or so with you once a week (2-3 time) and show you how you can take back control by owning all your notes on your own website. This is why movements like #DoOO and #IndieWeb so important. Curate your space, not reinforce hate
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
@Ebonyteach Can I please spend hour or so with you once a week (2-3 time) and show you how you can take back control by owning all your notes on your own website. This is why movements like #DoOO and #IndieWeb so important.

Curate your space, not reinforce hate
